trust_decision.summary: updateConfig(key, value) decides which property of the global Tamagui config the caller-supplied key may select as Object.assign target; at the pinned commit nothing is decided, so an inherited key ('__proto__', 'constructor') selects Object.prototype/Object and the value's keys are copied onto it.

landing_point.why: The summary names config.ts updateConfig directly; the sink is the one-line Object.assign at config.ts:170.

fix_sites.entry_point: public export updateConfig from @tamagui/web (code/core/web/src/index.ts:67), re-exported by @tamagui/core/tamagui

O3_reason_to_dismiss: updateConfig is commented 'for usage internally only' (code/core/web/src/config.ts:168) and its only in-repo caller passes the fixed key 'themes' (code/core/theme/src/_mutateTheme.ts:139); the name-keyed writers in O8 only rewire one container's prototype via the __proto__ setter, never Object.prototype, so a solver can argue they are not the advisory's global pollution.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: updateConfig('themes', {...}) must still merge new theme entries into config.themes (exercised by mutateThemes/addTheme/updateTheme/replaceTheme); a fix that rejects all non-allowlisted keys or deep-freezes config breaks theme mutation.

O6_input_shapes: key string naming an inherited Object.prototype member such as '__proto__' (fix.diff:28)
key not present on config at all (guard returns early, fix.diff:55-57)
missing config (guard returns when config is null, fix.diff:55)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: setConfigFont / insertFont / updateFont write config.fonts[name] with a caller-supplied font name and no own-key check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: name '__proto__' only replaces the prototype of config.fonts (local), not Object.prototype; different function from updateConfig

O8_uncovered_routes.route: addFont writes config.fonts[fontFamilyName] and config.fontsParsed with caller-supplied name, no own-key check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: separate package (@tamagui/font); local container prototype only

O8_uncovered_routes.route: addTheme/updateTheme/replaceTheme/mutateThemes write config.themes[themeName] with caller-supplied name before calling updateConfig('themes', ...)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the key passed to updateConfig is the fixed 'themes'; the name-keyed write happens before the guarded call and only affects config.themes' prototype

O8_uncovered_routes.route: loadAnimationDriver writes config.animations[name] with a caller-supplied driver name
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: documented public lazy-load API; local container prototype only

O8b_injection_room.sibling: theme 'update' mutation that deep-merges themeIn into the existing theme with a for-in copy instead of a spread
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: update semantics invite a recursive merge of nested theme values; a maintainer could swap the spread for a deep-merge helper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: loadAnimationDriver merging a driver-config object into config.animations via Object.assign(config.animations[name], driver)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: mirrors updateConfig's Object.assign-into-config[key] idiom in the same file

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) via caller-selected Object.assign target in a global config updater

O10_build.project_tests: code/core/core-test/*.web.test.tsx via `bun run test:web`; fix adds code/core/core-test/updateConfig.web.test.tsx

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject only the literal key '__proto__' in updateConfig, leaving 'constructor'/'prototype'-style inherited keys open.

out_of_scope_notes: getSetting (code/core/web/src/config.ts:65-77) falls back to config[key] for unknown settings keys; read-only, not pursued.
unverified: single_site is flagged because the published fix is one guard in one function and the O8 routes do not reach Object.prototype (they only swap one container's prototype via the __proto__ setter); if the benchmark counts local container-prototype rewiring under CWE-1321, drop the flag and treat O8 as weak Pattern B.
